title: FingerViP: Learning Real-World Dexterous Manipulation with Fingertip Visual Perception
summary: The current practice of dexterous manipulation generally relies on a single wrist-mounted view, which is often occluded and limits performance on tasks requiring multi-view perception. In this work, we present FingerViP, a learning system that utilizes a visuomotor policy with fingertip visual perception for dexterous manipulation. Specifically, we design a vision-enhanced fingertip module with an embedded miniature camera and install the modules on each finger of a multi-fingered hand. The fingertip cameras substantially improve visual perception by providing comprehensive, multi-view feedback of both the hand and its surrounding environment. Building on the integrated fingertip modules, we develop a diffusion-based whole-body visuomotor policy conditioned on a third-view camera and multi-view fingertip vision, which effectively learns complex manipulation skills directly from human demonstrations. To improve view-proprioception alignment and contact awareness, each fingertip visual feature is augmented with its corresponding camera pose encoding and per-finger joint-current encoding. We validate the effectiveness of the multi-view fingertip vision and demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of FingerViP on various challenging real-world tasks, including pressing buttons inside a confined box, retrieving sticks from an unstable support, retrieving objects behind an occluding curtain, and performing long-horizon cabinet opening and object retrieval, achieving an overall success rate of 80.8%. All hardware designs and code will be fully open-sourced.
tldr: FingerViP introduces a dexterous manipulation system using a visuomotor policy with multi-view fingertip cameras to improve perception, achieving high success rates on complex real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: FingerViP 提出了一种灵巧操作系统，利用带有多视角指尖摄像头的视觉运动策略来提升感知能力，在复杂的现实世界任务中实现了高成功率。
summary_zh: 当前灵巧操控的实践通常依赖于单一腕部视角，该视角常因遮挡问题而受限，难以满足需要多视角感知的任务需求。本研究提出FingerViP——一种基于指尖视觉感知的视觉运动策略学习系统，用于实现灵巧操控。具体而言，我们设计了一款集成微型摄像头的视觉增强指尖模块，并将其安装在多指手的每个手指上。指尖摄像头通过提供手部及其周围环境全面、多视角的实时反馈，显著提升了视觉感知能力。基于集成化指尖模块，我们开发了基于扩散模型的全身视觉运动策略，该策略融合了第三方视角摄像头与多视角指尖视觉信息，能够直接从人类演示中高效学习复杂的操控技能。为增强视角-本体感知对齐与接触感知能力，每个指尖视觉特征均与其对应的相机位姿编码及单指关节电流编码进行融合增强。我们通过实验验证了多视角指尖视觉的有效性，并展示了FingerViP在多种挑战性现实任务中的稳健性与适应性，包括：在受限空间内按压按钮、从非稳定支撑物上拾取细杆、在遮挡幕布后获取物体，以及执行长时序柜门开启与物体抓取任务，整体成功率达到了80.8%。所有硬件设计方案与代码将全面开源。

title: CorridorVLA: Explicit Spatial Constraints for Generative Action Heads via Sparse Anchors
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often use intermediate representations to connect multimodal inputs with continuous control, yet spatial guidance is often injected implicitly through latent features. We propose $CorridorVLA$, which predicts sparse spatial anchors as incremental physical changes (e.g., $Δ$-positions) and uses them to impose an explicit tolerance region in the training objective for action generation. The anchors define a corridor that guides a flow-matching action head: trajectories whose implied spatial evolution falls outside it receive corrective gradients, while minor deviations from contacts and execution noise are permitted. On the more challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark, CorridorVLA yields consistent gains across both SmolVLA and GR00T, improving success rate by $3.4\%$--$12.4\%$ over the corresponding baselines; notably, our GR00T-Corr variant reaches a success rate of $83.21\%$. These results indicate that action-aligned physical cues can provide direct and interpretable constraints for generative action policies, complementing spatial guidance encoded in visual or latent forms. Code is available at https://github.com/corridorVLA.
tldr: The paper proposes CorridorVLA, a method for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that uses explicit spatial anchors to define a tolerance corridor for training generative action heads, improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出CorridorVLA方法，通过显式的空间锚点定义容忍走廊来训练视觉-语言-动作模型中的生成式动作头，在机器人操作基准上取得了性能提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型常通过中间表征连接多模态输入与连续控制，但空间引导通常以隐式方式通过潜在特征注入。我们提出 $CorridorVLA$ 方法，通过预测稀疏空间锚点作为增量物理变化（如 $Δ$ 位置），并利用其在训练目标中构建显式容差区域以指导动作生成。这些锚点定义了一条"走廊"，引导流匹配动作头：隐含空间演化超出该区域的轨迹将收到修正梯度，同时允许与接触点和执行噪声的微小偏差。在更具挑战性的 LIBERO-Plus 基准测试中，CorridorVLA 在 SmolVLA 和 GR00T 模型上均取得持续提升，成功率较对应基线提高 $3.4\%$--$12.4\%$；特别值得注意的是，我们的 GR00T-Corr 变体实现了 $83.21\%$ 的成功率。这些结果表明，动作对齐的物理线索能为生成式动作策略提供直接且可解释的约束，与视觉或潜在形式编码的空间引导形成有效互补。代码已发布于 https://github.com/corridorVLA。

title: Long-Horizon Manipulation via Trace-Conditioned VLA Planning
summary: Long-horizon manipulation remains challenging for vision-language-action (VLA) policies: real tasks are multi-step, progress-dependent, and brittle to compounding execution errors. We present LoHo-Manip, a modular framework that scales short-horizon VLA execution to long-horizon instruction following via a dedicated task-management VLM. The manager is decoupled from the executor and is invoked in a receding-horizon manner: given the current observation, it predicts a progress-aware remaining plan that combines (i) a subtask sequence with an explicit done + remaining split as lightweight language memory, and (ii) a visual trace -- a compact 2D keypoint trajectory prompt specifying where to go and what to approach next. The executor VLA is adapted to condition on the rendered trace, thereby turning long-horizon decision-making into repeated local control by following the trace. Crucially, predicting the remaining plan at each step yields an implicit closed loop: failed steps persist in subsequent outputs, and traces update accordingly, enabling automatic continuation and replanning without hand-crafted recovery logic or brittle visual-history buffers. Extensive experiments spanning embodied planning, long-horizon reasoning, trajectory prediction, and end-to-end manipulation in simulation and on a real Franka robot demonstrate strong gains in long-horizon success, robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Project page: https://www.liuisabella.com/LoHoManip
tldr: Proposes a modular framework, LoHo-Manip, for scaling short-horizon VLA policies to long-horizon robot manipulation tasks using a task-manager VLM that predicts progress-aware plans and visual traces for receding-horizon control.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个模块化框架LoHo-Manip，通过一个任务管理VLM预测进度感知的剩余计划和视觉轨迹，将短视距VLA策略扩展至长视距机器人操作任务，实现滑动窗口控制。
summary_zh: 摘要：对于视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略而言，长时程操作依然面临挑战：真实任务通常包含多步骤、依赖任务进展，且对执行误差的累积效应较为敏感。本文提出LoHo-Manip，一个模块化框架，通过专门的任务管理视觉语言模型（VLM），将短时程VLA执行扩展至长时程指令跟随。管理器与执行器解耦，并以滚动时域方式调用：根据当前观测状态，它预测一个具备进度感知的剩余计划，该计划融合了（1）带有显式"已完成+未完成"划分的轻量级语言记忆子任务序列，以及（2）视觉轨迹提示——一种紧凑的二维关键点轨迹提示，用于指定下一步移动方向和交互目标。执行器VLA经过适配可基于渲染的轨迹提示进行条件控制，从而通过跟随轨迹将长时程决策转化为重复的局部控制。关键在于，每一步对剩余计划的预测形成了隐式闭环：失败步骤会持续出现在后续输出中，轨迹提示亦相应更新，实现了无需人工设计恢复逻辑或脆弱视觉历史缓冲的自动延续与重规划。在仿真环境及真实Franka机器人上开展的涵盖具身规划、长时程推理、轨迹预测和端到端操作的广泛实验表明，该方法在长时程任务成功率、鲁棒性及分布外泛化能力方面均取得显著提升。项目主页：https://www.liuisabella.com/LoHoManip

title: VistaBot: View-Robust Robot Manipulation via Spatiotemporal-Aware View Synthesis
summary: Recently, end-to-end robotic manipulation models have gained significant attention for their generalizability and scalability. However, they often suffer from limited robustness to camera viewpoint changes when training with a fixed camera. In this paper, we propose VistaBot, a novel framework that integrates feed-forward geometric models with video diffusion models to achieve view-robust closed-loop manipulation without requiring camera calibration at test time. Our approach consists of three key components: 4D geometry estimation, view synthesis latent extraction, and latent action learning. VistaBot is integrated into both action-chunking (ACT) and diffusion-based ($π_0$) policies and evaluated across simulation and real-world tasks. We further introduce the View Generalization Score (VGS) as a new metric for comprehensive evaluation of cross-view generalization. Results show that VistaBot improves VGS by 2.79$\times$ and 2.63$\times$ over ACT and $π_0$, respectively, while also achieving high-quality novel view synthesis. Our contributions include a geometry-aware synthesis model, a latent action planner, a new benchmark metric, and extensive validation across diverse environments. The code and models will be made publicly available.
tldr: A framework for view-robust robot manipulation that combines geometric models and video diffusion for novel view synthesis and action learning, improving generalization without camera calibration.
tldr_zh: 一个用于视图鲁棒机器人操作的框架，结合几何模型和视频扩散模型进行新视图合成与动作学习，无需相机标定即可提高泛化能力。
summary_zh: 近年来，端到端机器人操作模型因其泛化能力和可扩展性而备受关注。然而，当使用固定相机进行训练时，这些模型往往对相机视角变化的鲁棒性有限。本文提出VistaBot，一种将前馈几何模型与视频扩散模型相结合的新型框架，无需在测试时进行相机标定即可实现视角鲁棒的闭环操作。我们的方法包含三个关键组成部分：四维几何估计、视角合成潜在特征提取和潜在动作学习。VistaBot被集成到动作分块（ACT）和基于扩散（$π_0$）的策略中，并在仿真和实际任务中进行了评估。我们进一步提出了视角泛化评分（VGS）作为综合评价跨视角泛化能力的新指标。实验结果表明，VistaBot在ACT和$π_0$上的VGS分别提升了2.79倍和2.63倍，同时实现了高质量的新视角合成。我们的贡献包括几何感知的合成模型、潜在动作规划器、新的基准度量指标，以及在不同环境下的广泛验证。代码与模型将公开发布。

title: Hi-WM: Human-in-the-World-Model for Scalable Robot Post-Training
summary: Post-training is essential for turning pretrained generalist robot policies into reliable task-specific controllers, but existing human-in-the-loop pipelines remain tied to physical execution: each correction requires robot time, scene setup, resets, and operator supervision in the real world. Meanwhile, action-conditioned world models have been studied mainly for imagination, synthetic data generation, and policy evaluation. We propose \textbf{Human-in-the-World-Model (Hi-WM)}, a post-training framework that uses a learned world model as a reusable corrective substrate for failure-targeted policy improvement. A policy is first rolled out in closed loop inside the world model; when the rollout becomes incorrect or failure-prone, a human intervenes directly in the model to provide short corrective actions. Hi-WM caches intermediate states and supports rollback and branching, allowing a single failure state to be reused for multiple corrective continuations and yielding dense supervision around behaviors that the base policy handles poorly. The resulting corrective trajectories are then added back to the training set for post-training. We evaluate Hi-WM on three real-world manipulation tasks spanning both rigid and deformable object interaction, and on two policy backbones. Hi-WM improves real-world success by 37.9 points on average over the base policy and by 19.0 points over a world-model closed-loop baseline, while world-model evaluation correlates strongly with real-world performance (r = 0.953). These results suggest that world models can serve not only as generators or evaluators, but also as effective corrective substrates for scalable robot post-training.
tldr: Hi-WM proposes a robot post-training framework where human corrections are made directly within an action-conditioned world model, enabling scalable policy improvement for real-world manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Hi-WM 提出了一个机器人后训练框架，其中人类校正直接在动作条件世界模型中进行，从而实现真实世界操作任务的可扩展策略改进。
summary_zh: 后训练是将预训练的通用机器人策略转化为可靠任务专用控制器的关键环节，但现有的人机协同流程仍受限于物理执行：每次纠错都需要在现实世界中消耗机器人时间、搭建场景、重置环境并进行人工监督。与此同时，动作条件世界模型的研究主要集中于想象模拟、合成数据生成与策略评估。本文提出**人机协同世界模型（Hi-WM）**——一种后训练框架，将习得的世界模型作为可复用的纠错载体，针对策略失效进行针对性改进。该框架首先在世界模型内部进行闭环策略推演；当推演出现错误或失效风险时，人类直接在模型中进行干预，提供短时纠正动作。Hi-WM能够缓存中间状态并支持回滚与分支推演，允许将单一失效状态复用于多组纠错延续，从而在基础策略表现不佳的行为区域获得密集监督信号。生成的纠错轨迹随后被添加至训练集用于后训练。我们在涵盖刚性与可变形物体交互的三项真实世界操控任务及两种策略架构上评估Hi-WM。实验表明，相较于基础策略，Hi-WM将现实任务成功率平均提升37.9个百分点；相较于世界模型闭环基线提升19.0个百分点，且世界模型评估结果与现实表现呈现强相关性（r = 0.953）。这些结果证明世界模型不仅能作为生成器或评估器，还能成为可扩展机器人后训练的高效纠错载体。

title: SLAM as a Stochastic Control Problem with Partial Information: Optimal Solutions and Rigorous Approximations
summary: Simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) is a foundational state estimation problem in robotics in which a robot accurately constructs a map of its environment while also localizing itself within this construction. We study the active SLAM problem through the lens of optimal stochastic control, thereby recasting it as a decision-making problem under partial information. After reviewing several commonly studied models, we present a general stochastic control formulation of active SLAM together with a rigorous treatment of motion, sensing, and map representation. We introduce a new exploration stage cost that encodes the geometry of the state when evaluating information-gathering actions. This formulation, constructed as a nonstandard partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), is then analyzed to derive rigorously justified approximate solutions that are near-optimal. To enable this analysis, the associated regularity conditions are studied under general assumptions that apply to a wide range of robotics applications. For a particular case, we conduct an extensive numerical study in which standard learning algorithms are used to learn near-optimal policies.
tldr: This paper reframes the active SLAM problem as a stochastic optimal control problem with partial information, analyzing it as a POMDP to derive rigorous near-optimal approximations and learning policies.
tldr_zh: 本文将主动SLAM问题重新表述为具有部分信息的随机最优控制问题，并作为POMDP进行分析以推导严格的近似最优解和学习策略。
summary_zh: 同步定位与建图（SLAM）是机器人学中的基础状态估计问题，旨在使机器人能在构建环境地图的同时准确定位自身位置。本文从最优随机控制视角研究主动SLAM问题，将其重新定义为部分信息下的决策问题。在综述多种经典模型后，我们提出了主动SLAM的通用随机控制框架，并对运动、感知及地图表征进行了严格建模。我们提出了一种新型探索阶段代价函数，该函数在评估信息采集动作时能编码状态空间的几何特性。这一被构建为非标准部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的框架，经分析推导出具有严格理论依据的近似最优解。为支撑该分析，我们在适用于多种机器人应用的通用假设下研究了相关正则性条件。针对特定案例，我们开展了大规模数值研究，通过标准学习算法训练出近似最优策略。

title: Task-specific Subnetwork Discovery in Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Underwater Navigation
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles are required to perform multiple tasks adaptively and in an explainable manner under dynamic, uncertain conditions and limited sensing, challenges that classical controllers struggle to address. This demands robust, generalizable, and inherently interpretable control policies for reliable long-term monitoring. Reinforcement learning, particularly multi-task RL, overcomes these limitations by leveraging shared representations to enable efficient adaptation across tasks and environments. However, while such policies show promising results in simulation and controlled experiments, they yet remain opaque and offer limited insight into the agent's internal decision-making, creating gaps in transparency, trust, and safety that hinder real-world deployment. The internal policy structure and task-specific specialization remain poorly understood. To address these gaps, we analyze the internal structure of a pretrained multi-task reinforcement learning network in the HoloOcean simulator for underwater navigation by identifying and comparing task-specific subnetworks responsible for navigating toward different species. We find that in a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning setting with related tasks, the network uses only about 1.5% of its weights to differentiate between tasks. Of these, approximately 85% connect the context-variable nodes in the input layer to the next hidden layer, highlighting the importance of context variables in such settings. Our approach provides insights into shared and specialized network components, useful for efficient model editing, transfer learning, and continual learning for underwater monitoring through a contextual multi-task reinforcement learning method.
tldr: This paper analyzes task-specific subnetworks within a multi-task reinforcement learning policy for autonomous underwater navigation, aiming to improve interpretability and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了用于自主水下导航的多任务强化学习策略中的任务特定子网络，旨在提高可解释性和效率。
summary_zh: 自主水下航行器需要在动态、不确定条件和有限感知能力下，以自适应且可解释的方式执行多任务，这是传统控制器难以应对的挑战。这要求控制策略具备鲁棒性、可泛化性和本质可解释性，以实现可靠的长期监测。强化学习，尤其是多任务强化学习，通过利用共享表征实现在不同任务和环境中的高效适应，从而克服了这些限制。然而，尽管此类策略在模拟和受控实验中展现出良好效果，其决策过程仍不透明，难以洞察智能体的内部决策机制，导致在透明度、可信度和安全性方面存在缺陷，阻碍了实际应用部署。目前，对于内部策略结构及任务特化机制的理解仍显不足。为填补这些空白，我们以HoloOcean水下导航模拟器为平台，通过识别并比较负责朝向不同物种导航的任务特定子网络，分析了预训练多任务强化学习网络的内部结构。研究发现，在相关任务构成的上下文多任务强化学习环境中，网络仅使用约1.5%的权重来区分不同任务。其中约85%的权重连接输入层中的上下文变量节点与下一隐藏层，突显了此类设置中上下文变量的重要性。我们的方法揭示了网络中的共享与特化组件，为通过上下文多任务强化学习方法实现高效模型编辑、迁移学习及持续学习提供了重要参考，有助于推动水下监测领域的发展。

title: X2-N: A Transformable Wheel-legged Humanoid Robot with Dual-mode Locomotion and Manipulation
summary:
Wheel-legged robots combine the efficiency of wheeled locomotion with the versatility of legged systems, enabling rapid traversal over both continuous and discrete terrains. However, conventional designs typically employ fixed wheels as feet and limited degrees of freedom (DoFs) at the hips, resulting in reduced stability and mobility during legged locomotion compared to humanoids with flat feet. In addition, most existing platforms lack a full upper body with arms, which limits their ability to perform dexterous manipulation tasks.
  In this letter, we present X2-N, a high-DoF transformable robot with dual-mode locomotion and manipulation. X2-N can operate in both humanoid and wheel-legged forms and transform seamlessly between them through joint reconfiguration. We further propose a reinforcement learning (RL)-based whole-body control framework tailored to this morphology, enabling unified control across hybrid locomotion, transformation, and manipulation. We validate X2-N in a range of challenging locomotion and manipulation tasks, including dynamic skating-like motion, stair climbing and package delivery. Results demonstrate high locomotion efficiency, strong terrain adaptability, and stable loco-manipulation performance of X2-N, highlighting its potential for real-world deployment.
tldr: A transformable wheel-legged humanoid robot with a novel dual-mode locomotion and manipulation morphology, controlled by a reinforcement learning-based whole-body control framework, validated in complex locomotion and loco-manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 一种可变形轮腿式人形机器人，具有新颖的双模式运动与操作形态，采用基于强化学习的全身控制框架，在复杂运动和运动操作任务中进行了验证。
summary_zh:
轮腿式机器人融合了轮式运动的高效性与腿式系统的多地形适应能力，能够快速穿越连续与非连续地形。然而，传统设计通常采用固定轮作为足部，且髋关节自由度有限，导致其腿式运动时的稳定性和移动能力相较于具有扁平足的人形机器人有所不足。此外，现有平台大多缺乏配备完整手臂的上半身结构，限制了其执行灵巧操作任务的能力。

本文提出X2-N机器人——一种具备双模式运动与操作能力的高自由度可变形机器人。X2-N既可切换为人形模式，也可转换为轮腿形态，并能通过关节重构实现形态间的无缝切换。我们进一步提出一种基于强化学习的全身控制框架，专门适配该机器人的形态特点，实现对混合运动、形态转换与操作任务的一体化控制。通过动态滑行运动、楼梯攀爬及包裹递送等一系列挑战性任务验证，实验结果表明X2-N具备高运动效率、强地形适应能力以及稳定的运动-操作协同性能，展现了其在现实场景中应用的潜力。

title: From Noise to Intent: Anchoring Generative VLA Policies with Residual Bridges
summary: Bridging high-level semantic understanding with low-level physical control remains a persistent challenge in embodied intelligence, stemming from the fundamental spatiotemporal scale mismatch between cognition and action. Existing generative VLA policies typically adopt a "Generation-from-Noise" paradigm, which disregards this disparity, leading to representation inefficiency and weak condition alignment during optimization. In this work, we propose ResVLA, an architecture that shifts the paradigm to "Refinement-from-Intent." Recognizing that robotic motion naturally decomposes into global intent and local dynamics, ResVLA utilizes spectral analysis to decouple control into a deterministic low-frequency anchor and a stochastic high-frequency residual. By anchoring the generative process on the predicted intent, our model focuses strictly on refining local dynamics via a residual diffusion bridge. Extensive simulation experiments show that ResVLA achieves competitive performance, strong robustness to language and robot embodiment perturbations, and faster convergence than standard generative baselines. It also demonstrates strong performance in real-world robot experiments.
tldr: The paper introduces ResVLA, a generative Vision-Language-Action architecture for robotics that decomposes motion into global intent and local dynamics, anchoring generation on predicted intent to refine control via a residual diffusion bridge, showing strong results in sim and real-world.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了ResVLA，这是一种用于机器人生成的视觉-语言-动作架构，它将运动解耦为全局意图和局部动态，通过将生成过程锚定在预测的意图上，利用残差扩散桥来优化控制，在仿真和真实机器人实验中表现出色。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在具身智能中，如何将高层语义理解与底层物理控制相统一仍是一个长期存在的挑战，其根源在于认知与行动之间存在根本的时空尺度不匹配。现有的生成式视觉语言动作（VLA）策略通常采用“从噪声生成”的范式，忽视了这种差异，导致优化过程中表征效率低下且条件对齐能力较弱。本文提出ResVLA架构，将范式转向“从意图细化”。基于机器人运动天然可分解为全局意图与局部动态的特性，ResVLA利用频谱分析将控制解耦为确定性低频锚点与随机性高频残差。通过将生成过程锚定于预测的意图，我们的模型严格聚焦于通过残差扩散桥细化局部动态。大量仿真实验表明，ResVLA在取得优异性能的同时，对语言及机器人本体扰动表现出强鲁棒性，且收敛速度快于标准生成基线。该模型在真实机器人实验中也展现出强大的性能。

title: A Deployable Embodied Vision-Language Navigation System with Hierarchical Cognition and Context-Aware Exploration
summary: Bridging the gap between embodied intelligence and embedded deployment remains a key challenge in intelligent robotic systems, where perception, reasoning, and planning must operate under strict constraints on computation, memory, energy, and real-time execution. In vision-language navigation (VLN), existing approaches often face a fundamental trade-off between strong reasoning capabilities and efficient deployment on real-world platforms. In this paper, we present a deployable embodied VLN system that achieves both high efficiency and robust high-level reasoning on real-world robotic platforms. To achieve this, we decouple the system into three asynchronous modules: a real-time perception module for continuous environment sensing, a memory integration module for spatial-semantic aggregation, and a reasoning module for high-level decision making. We incrementally construct a cognitive memory graph to encode scene information, which is further decomposed into subgraphs to enable reasoning with a vision-language model (VLM). To further improve navigation efficiency and accuracy, we also leverage the cognitive memory graph to formulate the exploration problem as a context-aware Weighted Traveling Repairman Problem (WTRP), which minimizes the weighted waiting time of viewpoints. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate improved navigation success and efficiency over existing VLN approaches, while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained hardware.
tldr: This paper presents a deployable Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) system for real-world robots using a hierarchical cognitive architecture with asynchronous modules and a context-aware planning formulation to improve efficiency and performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可部署的视觉语言导航系统，适用于真实世界机器人平台，该系统采用分层认知架构和异步模块，结合上下文感知规划，以提高导航效率和性能。
summary_zh: 在智能机器人系统中，感知、推理与规划必须严格受限于计算、内存、能耗和实时性要求，如何弥合具身智能与嵌入式部署之间的鸿沟仍是核心挑战。在视觉语言导航（VLN）领域，现有方法往往在强推理能力与真实平台高效部署之间存在根本性的权衡。本文提出一种可部署的具身VLN系统，在真实机器人平台上同时实现高效率与鲁棒的高层推理。为实现这一目标，我们将系统解耦为三个异步模块：用于持续环境感知的实时感知模块、用于空间语义聚合的记忆整合模块，以及用于高层决策的推理模块。我们通过增量构建认知记忆图来编码场景信息，并将其进一步分解为子图以利用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行推理。为提升导航效率与准确性，我们还将认知记忆图用于将探索问题建模为上下文感知的加权旅行维修员问题（WTRP），以最小化视点加权等待时间。在仿真与真实机器人平台上的大量实验表明，本系统在保持资源受限硬件上实时性能的同时，导航成功率与效率均优于现有VLN方法。

title: RPG: Robust Policy Gating for Smooth Multi-Skill Transitions in Humanoid Fighting
summary: Humanoid robots have demonstrated impressive motor skills in a wide range of tasks, yet whole-body control for humanlike long-time, dynamic fighting remains particularly challenging due to the stringent requirements on agility and stability. While imitation learning enables robots to execute human-like fighting skills, existing approaches often rely on switching among multiple single-skill policies or employing a general policy to imitate input reference motions. These strategies suffer from instability when transitioning between skills, as the mismatch of initial and terminal states across skills or reference motions introduces out-of-domain disturbances, resulting in unsmooth or unstable behaviors. In this work, we propose RPG, a hybrid expert policy framework, for smooth and stable humanoid multi-skills transition. Our approach incorporates motion transition randomization and temporal randomization to train a unified policy that generates agile fighting actions with stability and smoothness during skill transitions. Furthermore, we design a control pipeline that integrates walking/running locomotion with fighting skills, allowing humanlike long-time combat of arbitrary duration that can be seamlessly interrupted or transit action policies at any time. Extensive experiments in simulation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, and real-world deployment on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot further validates its robustness and applicability.
tldr: This paper introduces RPG, a robust policy gating framework for smooth transitions between multiple fighting skills in humanoid robots, combining imitation learning, motion randomization, and a unified policy to enable agile, stable, and long-duration combat.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RPG框架，通过运动转换随机化和时序随机化训练统一策略，实现人形机器人多战斗技能间的平稳、稳定过渡，并在仿真和真实机器人G1上验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 类人机器人已在众多任务中展现出卓越的运动能力，然而由于对敏捷性与稳定性的严苛要求，实现类人化的长时间动态格斗全身控制仍面临特殊挑战。虽然模仿学习能使机器人执行拟人格斗动作，但现有方法通常依赖多个单技能策略间的切换或采用通用策略模仿输入参考动作。这些策略在技能转换时存在稳定性问题——不同技能或参考动作间初始状态与终止状态的错配会引发域外扰动，导致行为不平滑或不稳定。本研究提出RPG混合专家策略框架，旨在实现类人机器人多技能间的平滑稳定转换。该方法通过动作过渡随机化与时间随机化训练统一策略，在技能转换时生成兼具稳定性与流畅度的敏捷格斗动作。此外，我们设计了整合行走/跑动步态与格斗技能的控制流程，支持任意时长的类人化持续战斗，并可在任意时刻无缝中断或切换动作策略。大量仿真实验验证了该框架的有效性，在宇树G1类人机器人上的实际部署进一步证明了其鲁棒性与适用性。

title: Learn Weightlessness: Imitate Non-Self-Stabilizing Motions on Humanoid Robot
summary: The integration of imitation and reinforcement learning has enabled remarkable advances in humanoid whole-body control, facilitating diverse human-like behaviors. However, research on environment-dependent motions remains limited. Existing methods typically enforce rigid trajectory tracking while neglecting physical interactions with the environment. We observe that humans naturally exploit a "weightless" state during non-self-stabilizing (NSS) motions--selectively relaxing specific joints to allow passive body--environment contact, thereby stabilizing the body and completing the motion. Inspired by this biological mechanism, we design a weightlessness-state auto-labeling strategy for dataset annotation; and we propose the Weightlessness Mechanism (WM), a method that dynamically determines which joints to relax and to what level, together enabling effective environmental interaction while executing target motions. We evaluate our approach on 3 representative NSS tasks: sitting on chairs of varying heights, lying down on beds with different inclinations, and leaning against walls via shoulder or elbow. Extensive experiments in simulation and on the Unitree G1 robot demonstrate that our WM method, trained on single-action demonstrations without any task-specific tuning, achieves strong generalization across diverse environmental configurations while maintaining motion stability. Our work bridges the gap between precise trajectory tracking and adaptive environmental interaction, offering a biologically-inspired solution for contact-rich humanoid control.
tldr: The paper introduces a biologically-inspired 'Weightlessness Mechanism' for humanoid robot control, enabling robust imitation of non-self-stabilizing motions by selectively relaxing joints to exploit environmental contact. It is validated on tasks like sitting, lying down, and leaning against varied surfaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种受生物启发的'失重机制'，用于人形机器人控制，通过选择性放松关节以利用环境接触，从而鲁棒地模仿非自稳定运动，并在坐、躺、靠等任务上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 模仿学习与强化学习的融合在人形机器人全身控制领域取得了显著进展，促进了多样化类人行为的实现。然而，针对环境依赖型运动的研究仍较为有限。现有方法通常强制进行刚性轨迹跟踪，却忽略了与环境的物理交互。我们观察到，人类在非自稳定运动过程中会自然利用“失重”状态——通过选择性放松特定关节，允许身体被动接触环境，从而稳定身体并完成动作。受此生物机制启发，我们设计了一种用于数据集标注的失重状态自动标记策略，并提出失重机制方法。该方法能够动态决定需要放松的关节及其放松程度，从而在执行目标动作时实现有效的环境交互。我们在三种代表性非自稳定任务中评估了所提方法：坐在不同高度的椅子上、躺在不同倾斜度的床垫上，以及通过肩部或肘部倚靠墙壁。在仿真环境和Unitree G1机器人上进行的大量实验表明，我们的失重机制方法仅需单动作演示数据进行训练，无需任何任务特定调优，即可在不同环境配置中实现强泛化能力，同时保持运动稳定性。本工作填补了精确轨迹跟踪与自适应环境交互之间的空白，为接触密集型人形机器人控制提供了一种受生物启发的解决方案。

title: How VLAs (Really) Work In Open-World Environments
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have been extensively used in robotics applications, achieving great success in various manipulation problems. More recently, VLAs have been used in long-horizon tasks and evaluated on benchmarks, such as BEHAVIOR1K (B1K), for solving complex household chores. The common metric for measuring progress in such benchmarks is success rate or partial score based on satisfaction of progress-agnostic criteria, meaning only the final states of the objects are considered, regardless of the events that lead to such states. In this paper, we argue that using such evaluation protocols say little about safety aspects of operation and can potentially exaggerate reported performance, undermining core challenges for future real-world deployment. To this end, we conduct a thorough analysis of state-of-the-art models on the B1K Challenge and evaluate policies in terms of robustness via reproducibility and consistency of performance, safety aspects of policies operations, task awareness, and key elements leading to the incompletion of tasks. We then propose evaluation protocols to capture safety violations to better measure the true performance of the policies in more complex and interactive scenarios. At the end, we discuss the limitations of the existing VLAs and motivate future research.
tldr: This paper critically analyzes the safety and robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in long-horizon robotic tasks on the BEHAVIOR1K benchmark, highlighting the limitations of current evaluation metrics and proposing new protocols to capture safety violations.
tldr_zh: 该论文批判性地分析了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在BEHAVIOR1K基准中长期机器人任务中的安全性和鲁棒性，指出了当前评估指标的局限性，并提出了捕获安全违规行为的新协议。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）已在机器人应用中得到广泛使用，并在各类操作任务中取得了显著成功。近期，VLA开始被应用于长程任务，并在BEHAVIOR1K（B1K）等基准测试中接受评估，用于解决复杂的家庭日常事务。这类基准测试的常用评估指标是基于与过程无关的完成度标准计算的成功率或部分得分，即仅关注物体的最终状态，而忽略导致该状态的事件过程。本文认为，此类评估方法难以反映操作的安全特性，且可能夸大报告的性能表现，从而掩盖未来实际部署中的核心挑战。为此，我们对B1K挑战赛中的前沿模型进行了深入分析，通过性能的可复现性与一致性、策略操作的安全性、任务感知能力以及任务未完成的关键因素等方面评估策略的鲁棒性。进而提出能够捕捉安全违规行为的评估协议，以更准确地衡量策略在复杂交互场景中的真实性能。最后，我们讨论了现有VLA的局限性，并对未来研究方向进行了展望。

title: Full-Body Dynamic Safety for Robot Manipulators: 3D Poisson Safety Functions for CBF-Based Safety Filters
summary: Collision avoidance for robotic manipulators requires enforcing full-body safety constraints in high-dimensional configuration spaces. Control Barrier Function (CBF) based safety filters have proven effective in enabling safe behaviors, but enforcing the high number of constraints needed for safe manipulation leads to theoretic and computational challenges. This work presents a framework for full-body collision avoidance for manipulators in dynamic environments by leveraging 3D Poisson Safety Functions (PSFs). In particular, given environmental occupancy data, we sample the manipulator surface at a prescribed resolution and shrink free space via a Pontryagin difference according to this resolution. On this buffered domain, we synthesize a globally smooth CBF by solving Poisson's equation, yielding a single safety function for the entire environment. This safety function, evaluated at each sampled point, yields task-space CBF constraints enforced by a real-time safety filter via a multi-constraint quadratic program. We prove that keeping the sample points safe in the buffered region guarantees collision avoidance for the entire continuous robot surface. The framework is validated on a 7-degree-of-freedom manipulator in dynamic environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for full-body collision avoidance for robotic manipulators in dynamic environments using 3D Poisson Safety Functions and Control Barrier Function-based safety filters.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用3D泊松安全函数和控制屏障函数安全过滤器，为动态环境中的机器人操作器实现全身碰撞避免的框架。
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人机械臂的避障问题需要在高维构型空间中确保全身安全约束。基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的安全滤波器已被证明能够有效实现安全行为，但为确保机械臂安全操作而需强制执行的大量约束带来了理论与计算上的挑战。本研究提出了一种利用三维泊松安全函数（PSF）实现机械臂在动态环境中全身避障的框架。具体而言，给定环境占据数据，我们以预设分辨率对机械臂表面进行采样，并根据该分辨率通过庞特里亚金差分收缩自由空间。在此缓冲区域内，通过求解泊松方程合成了全局光滑的CBF，从而为整个环境生成单一安全函数。该安全函数在各采样点处的取值，通过多约束二次规划由实时安全滤波器强制执行任务空间CBF约束。我们证明，在缓冲区域内保持采样点安全即可保证整个连续机器人表面的避障性能。该框架在动态环境中的七自由度机械臂上得到了验证。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Manipulation Understanding with Enriched Semantic Event Chains
summary: Robotic systems operating in human environments must reason about how object interactions evolve over time, which actions are currently being performed, and what manipulation step is likely to follow. Classical enriched Semantic Event Chains (eSECs) provide an interpretable relational description of manipulation, but remain primarily descriptive and do not directly support uncertainty-aware decision making. In this paper, we propose eSEC-LAM, a neuro-symbolic framework that transforms eSECs into an explicit event-level symbolic state for manipulation understanding. The proposed formulation augments classical eSECs with confidence-aware predicates, functional object roles, affordance priors, primitive-level abstraction, and saliency-guided explanation cues. These enriched symbolic states are derived from a foundation-model-based perception front-end through deterministic predicate extraction, while current-action inference and next-primitive prediction are performed using lightweight symbolic reasoning over primitive pre- and post-conditions. We evaluate the proposed framework on EPIC-KITCHENS-100, EPIC-KITCHENS VISOR, and Assembly101 across action recognition, next-primitive prediction, robustness to perception noise, and explanation consistency. Experimental results show that eSEC-LAM achieves competitive action recognition, substantially improves next-primitive prediction, remains more robust under degraded perceptual conditions than both classical symbolic and end-to-end video baselines, and provides temporally consistent explanation traces grounded in explicit relational evidence. These findings demonstrate that enriched Semantic Event Chains can serve not only as interpretable descriptors of manipulation, but also as effective internal states for neuro-symbolic action reasoning.
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework (eSEC-LAM) that enhances classical Semantic Event Chains with probabilistic and functional elements to improve robot manipulation understanding, including action recognition, next-step prediction, and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架（eSEC-LAM），它增强了经典语义事件链，加入概率和功能元素，以提升机器人操作理解能力，包括动作识别、下一步预测和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在人类环境中运行的机器人系统必须能够推理物体交互随时间如何演变、当前正在执行何种动作、以及下一步可能进行何种操作。传统的增强型语义事件链（eSECs）提供了可解释的操作关系描述，但主要停留在描述层面，无法直接支持不确定性感知决策。本文提出eSEC-LAM——一种将eSECs转化为显式事件层符号状态的神经符号框架，用于操作理解。该框架通过置信度感知谓词、功能性物体角色、功能可供性先验、基元级抽象和显著性引导的解释线索，对传统eSECs进行了增强。这些增强的符号状态通过基于基础模型的感知前端进行确定性谓词抽取，而当前动作推断和下一基元预测则通过基元前/后置条件的轻量级符号推理实现。我们在EPIC-KITCHENS-100、EPIC-KITCHENS VISOR和Assembly101数据集上，从动作识别、下一基元预测、感知噪声鲁棒性和解释一致性四个维度评估了该框架。实验结果表明：eSEC-LAM在动作识别任务上具有竞争力，显著提升了下一基元预测性能，在感知退化条件下比传统符号方法和端到端视频基线模型更具鲁棒性，并能基于显式关系证据提供时序一致的解释轨迹。这些发现表明，增强型语义事件链不仅能作为可解释的操作描述符，还可成为神经符号动作推理的有效内部状态。

title: A Survey of Legged Robotics in Non-Inertial Environments: Past, Present, and Future
summary: Legged robots have demonstrated remarkable agility on rigid, stationary ground, but their locomotion reliability remains limited in non-inertial environments, where the supporting ground moves, tilts, or accelerates. Such conditions arise in ground transportation, maritime platforms, and aerospace settings, and they introduce persistent time-varying disturbances that break the stationary-ground assumptions underlying conventional legged locomotion. This survey reviews the state of the art in modeling, state estimation, and control for legged robots in non-inertial environments. We summarize representative application domains and motion characteristics, analyze the root causes of locomotion performance degradation, and review existing methods together with their key assumptions and limitations. We further identify open problems in robot-environment coupling, observability, robustness, and experimental validation, and discuss future directions in autonomy, system-level design, bio-inspired strategies, safety, and testing. The survey aims to clarify the technical foundations of this emerging area and support the development of reliable legged robots for real-world dynamic environments.
tldr: This survey reviews the state of the art in modeling, state estimation, and control for legged robots operating in non-inertial environments, such as moving or tilting platforms, identifying key challenges and future research directions.
tldr_zh: 本篇综述回顾了在非惯性环境中（如移动或倾斜平台）足式机器人的建模、状态估计和控制技术现状，总结了关键挑战和未来研究方向。
summary_zh: 四足机器人已在刚性地面上展现出卓越的敏捷性，但在非惯性环境（即支撑地面移动、倾斜或加速的场景）中，其运动可靠性仍存在局限。此类环境常见于地面运输、海上平台及航空航天领域，其所产生的持续时变扰动打破了传统四足运动所依赖的静态地面假设。本文综述了非惯性环境下四足机器人建模、状态估计与控制领域的最新进展，梳理了典型应用场景与运动特征，分析了运动性能下降的根本原因，并系统评述了现有方法及其核心假设与局限性。此外，本文进一步明确了机器人-环境耦合、可观性、鲁棒性及实验验证等方面存在的开放性问题，探讨了未来在自主性、系统级设计、仿生策略、安全性及测试验证等方面的发展方向。本综述旨在厘清这一新兴领域的技术基础，为推动四足机器人在真实动态环境中实现可靠运动提供支持。

title: ReCAPA: Hierarchical Predictive Correction to Mitigate Cascading Failures
summary: Vision-Language-Action systems follow instructions to execute multi-step tasks in multimodal environments. Recent VLA approaches typically rely on post-hoc correction mechanisms or operate under fixed task decompositions and alignment schemes. However, once an intermediate step is mis-specified, local errors propagate through subsequent steps and eventually accumulate into cascading failures. To mitigate this compounding effect, we propose Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture, a framework that uses prediction and contrast to adjust deviations across three levels: actions, subgoals, and trajectories. Semantic alignment is enforced at all levels using a Sinkhorn-based module and a Score-field module. The predictive correction and alignment jointly update the action generator during training, enabling it to adjust fine-grained steps to remain aligned with the overall intent. We further introduce two new metrics to quantify error propagation and recovery processes in tasks, capturing how mistakes spread and fade over long-horizon execution. Experiments show that ReCAPA achieves competitive results on embodied agent benchmarks such as VisualAgentBench, MineDojo, and AI2-THOR, outperforming strong proprietary and open-source Large Language Model baselines.
tldr: Proposes a hierarchical predictive correction framework for Vision-Language-Action systems to mitigate cascading failures in long-horizon embodied tasks, achieving competitive results on robotics and embodied AI benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一个分层的预测性校正框架，用于视觉-语言-行动系统，以减轻在长期具身任务中的级联失败，在机器人和具身智能基准测试中取得了有竞争力的结果。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作系统通过遵循指令在多模态环境中执行多步骤任务。当前的主流视觉-语言-动作方法通常依赖事后修正机制，或在固定任务分解与对齐方案下运行。然而，一旦中间步骤的设定出现偏差，局部错误会沿后续步骤传递，最终累积为级联式失败。为缓解此类复合效应，我们提出预测性对齐与规划架构，该框架通过预测与对比机制在三个层面修正偏差：动作、子目标与轨迹。基于Sinkhorn的模块与评分场模块实现了所有层级的语义对齐。训练过程中，预测性校正与对齐机制协同更新动作生成器，使其能够调整细粒度步骤以保持与整体意图的一致性。我们进一步提出两项新指标，用于量化任务中的错误传播与恢复过程，以捕捉长时序执行中错误的扩散与消退规律。实验表明，在具身智能体基准测试（如VisualAgentBench、MineDojo和AI2-THOR）中，ReCAPA取得了具有竞争力的结果，其性能优于主流专有模型与开源大型语言模型基线。

title: Instance-level Visual Active Tracking with Occlusion-Aware Planning
summary: Visual Active Tracking (VAT) aims to control cameras to follow a target in 3D space, which is critical for applications like drone navigation and security surveillance. However, it faces two key bottlenecks in real-world deployment: confusion from visually similar distractors caused by insufficient instance-level discrimination and severe failure under occlusions due to the absence of active planning. To address these, we propose OA-VAT, a unified pipeline with three complementary modules. First, a training-free Instance-Aware Offline Prototype Initialization aggregates multi-view augmented features via DINOv3 to construct discriminative instance prototypes, mitigating distractor confusion. Second, an Online Prototype Enhancement Tracker enhances prototypes online and integrates a confidence-aware Kalman filter for stable tracking under appearance and motion changes. Third, an Occlusion-Aware Trajectory Planner, trained on our new Planning-20k dataset, uses conditional diffusion to generate obstacle-avoiding paths for occlusion recovery. Experiments demonstrate OA-VAT achieves 0.93 average SR on UnrealCV (+2.2% vs. SOTA TrackVLA), 90.8% average CAR on real-world datasets (+12.1% vs. SOTA GC-VAT), and 81.6% TSR on a DJI Tello drone. Running at 35 FPS on an RTX 3090, it delivers robust, real-time performance for practical deployment.
tldr: This paper proposes OA-VAT, a unified pipeline for Visual Active Tracking (VAT) that uses instance-aware prototype initialization, an online tracker, and an occlusion-aware planner to robustly track a target in 3D space, achieving state-of-the-art results on simulated and real-world benchmarks, including drone tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出OA-VAT，一个用于视觉主动跟踪（VAT）的统一框架，通过实例感知原型初始化、在线跟踪器和遮挡感知规划器，在3D空间中鲁棒地跟踪目标，在模拟和真实世界基准测试（包括无人机测试）上取得了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉主动跟踪（VAT）旨在通过控制摄像机在三维空间中持续跟随目标，这对于无人机导航和安全监控等应用至关重要。然而，该技术在实际部署中面临两大关键瓶颈：因实例级判别力不足导致的视觉相似干扰物混淆，以及缺乏主动规划致使遮挡下跟踪严重失效。为解决这些问题，我们提出了OA-VAT——一个包含三个互补模块的统一框架。首先，通过免训练的实例感知离线原型初始化模块，利用DINOv3聚合多视图增强特征，构建具有判别力的实例原型以缓解干扰物混淆。其次，在线原型增强跟踪器动态优化原型，并结合置信度感知卡尔曼滤波器，在目标外观和运动变化下保持稳定跟踪。第三，基于我们新构建的Planning-20k数据集训练的遮挡感知轨迹规划器，采用条件扩散模型生成避障路径以实现遮挡恢复。实验表明，OA-VAT在UnrealCV数据集上达到0.93的平均成功率（较SOTA TrackVLA提升2.2%），在真实世界数据集上获得90.8%的平均跟踪准确率（较SOTA GC-VAT提升12.1%），并在DJI Tello无人机上实现81.6%的跟踪成功率。在RTX 3090显卡上以35 FPS实时运行，该方法为实际部署提供了鲁棒高效的解决方案。

title: Task-Driven Co-Design of Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Designing multi-agent robotic systems requires reasoning across tightly coupled decisions spanning heterogeneous domains, including robot design, fleet composition, and planning. Much effort has been devoted to isolated improvements in these domains, whereas system-level co-design considering trade-offs and task requirements remains underexplored. In this work, we present a formal and compositional framework for the task-driven co-design of heterogeneous multi-robot systems. Building on a monotone co-design theory, we introduce general abstractions of robots, fleets, planners, executors, and evaluators as interconnected design problems with well-defined interfaces that are agnostic to both implementations and tasks. This structure enables efficient joint optimization of robot design, fleet composition, and planning under task-specific performance constraints. A series of case studies demonstrates the capabilities of the framework. Various component models can be seamlessly incorporated, including new robot types, task profiles, and probabilistic sensing objectives, while non-obvious design alternatives are systematically uncovered with optimality guarantees. The results highlight the flexibility, scalability, and interpretability of the proposed approach, and illustrate how formal co-design enables principled reasoning about complex heterogeneous multi-robot systems.
tldr: This paper presents a formal framework for co-designing heterogeneous multi-robot systems, jointly optimizing robot design, fleet composition, and planning under task constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个异构多机器人系统协同设计的正式框架，在任务约束下联合优化机器人设计、车队构成和规划。
summary_zh: 设计多智能体机器人系统需要在异构领域（包括机器人设计、编队构成与路径规划）之间进行紧密耦合的决策推理。现有研究大多聚焦于各领域的孤立改进，而综合考虑权衡取舍与任务需求的系统级协同设计仍待深入探索。本文提出一种形式化、组合式的异构多机器人系统任务驱动协同设计框架。基于单调协同设计理论，我们引入机器人、编队、规划器、执行器与评估器的一般性抽象概念，将其视为具有明确定义接口的互连设计问题，这些接口独立于具体实现与任务类型。该结构能够在特定任务性能约束下，高效实现机器人设计、编队构成与路径规划的联合优化。系列案例研究验证了该框架的性能：各类组件模型（包括新型机器人类型、任务场景及概率感知目标）均可无缝集成，同时系统能够以最优性保证自动发现非显而易见的设计方案。研究结果凸显了所提方法的灵活性、可扩展性与可解释性，并阐明了形式化协同设计如何为复杂异构多机器人系统提供原则性推理支持。

title: A Bayesian Reasoning Framework for Robotic Systems in Autonomous Casualty Triage
summary: Autonomous robots deployed in mass casualty incidents (MCI) face the challenge of making critical decisions based on incomplete and noisy perceptual data. We present an autonomous robotic system for casualty assessment that fuses outputs from multiple vision-based algorithms, estimating signs of severe hemorrhage, visible trauma, or physical alertness, into a coherent triage assessment. At the core of our system is a Bayesian network, constructed from expert-defined rules, which enables probabilistic reasoning about a casualty's condition even with missing or conflicting sensory inputs. The system, evaluated during the DARPA Triage Challenge (DTC) in realistic MCI scenarios involving 11 and 9 casualties, demonstrated a nearly three-fold improvement in physiological assessment accuracy (from 15\% to 42\% and 19\% to 46\%) compared to a vision-only baseline. More importantly, overall triage accuracy increased from 14\% to 53\%, while the diagnostic coverage of the system expanded from 31\% to 95\% of cases. These results demonstrate that integrating expert-guided probabilistic reasoning with advanced vision-based sensing can significantly enhance the reliability and decision-making capabilities of autonomous systems in critical real-world applications.
tldr: This paper presents a Bayesian reasoning framework for autonomous robotic casualty triage, integrating vision-based sensing and expert rules to significantly improve assessment accuracy and diagnostic coverage in simulated mass casualty scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主机器人伤员分诊的贝叶斯推理框架，结合视觉感知和专家规则，在模拟大规模伤亡场景中显著提高了评估准确性和诊断覆盖率。
summary_zh: 在大规模伤亡事件中部署的自主机器人面临一项关键挑战：必须基于不完整且含有噪声的感知数据做出关键决策。本文提出一种用于伤员评估的自主机器人系统，该系统融合了多种基于视觉的算法输出——包括对严重出血、可见创伤或身体警觉性的体征估计，并将其整合为连贯的伤情分级评估。系统的核心是一个基于专家定义规则构建的贝叶斯网络，它能够在传感器输入缺失或矛盾的情况下，对伤员状况进行概率推理。该系统在DARPA伤情分级挑战赛的真实大规模伤亡场景中进行了评估（涉及11名和9名伤员），结果显示其生理评估准确率较纯视觉基线提升了近三倍（从15%提升至42%，从19%提升至46%）。更重要的是，整体伤情分级准确率从14%提高至53%，同时系统的诊断覆盖范围从31%的案例扩大至95%。这些结果表明，将专家指导的概率推理与先进的视觉感知技术相结合，能够显著提升自主系统在关键现实应用中的可靠性和决策能力。

title: Navigating the Clutter: Waypoint-Based Bi-Level Planning for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Multi-robot control in cluttered environments is a challenging problem that involves complex physical constraints, including robot-robot collisions, robot-obstacle collisions, and unreachable motions. Successful planning in such settings requires joint optimization over high-level task planning and low-level motion planning, as violations of physical constraints may arise from failures at either level. However, jointly optimizing task and motion planning is difficult due to the complex parameterization of low-level motion trajectories and the ambiguity of credit assignment across the two planning levels. In this paper, we propose a hybrid multi-robot control framework that jointly optimizes task and motion planning. To enable effective parameterization of low-level planning, we introduce waypoints, a simple yet expressive representation for motion trajectories. To address the credit assignment challenge, we adopt a curriculum-based training strategy with a modified RLVR algorithm that propagates motion feasibility feedback from the motion planner to the task planner. Experiments on BoxNet3D-OBS, a challenging multi-robot benchmark with dense obstacles and up to nine robots, show that our approach consistently improves task success over motion-agnostic and VLA-based baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/navigate-cluster
tldr: The paper introduces a hybrid multi-robot control framework using waypoints and curriculum-based RL to jointly optimize task and motion planning in cluttered environments, improving task success on a challenging benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合多机器人控制框架，使用路径点和课程强化学习来联合优化任务与运动规划，在充满密集障碍物的环境中提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中的多机器人控制是一个具有挑战性的问题，涉及复杂的物理约束，包括机器人之间的碰撞、机器人与障碍物的碰撞以及不可达运动。在此类场景下成功进行规划需要高层任务规划和低层运动规划的联合优化，因为违反物理约束可能源于任一规划层面的失败。然而，由于低层运动轨迹的复杂参数化以及两个规划层面之间的责任分配模糊性，任务与运动规划的联合优化非常困难。本文提出了一种混合多机器人控制框架，能够联合优化任务与运动规划。为实现低层规划的有效参数化，我们引入了路点——一种简单而富有表现力的运动轨迹表示方法。为解决责任分配的挑战，我们采用了基于课程学习的训练策略，结合改进的RLVR算法，将运动可行性反馈从运动规划器传递至任务规划器。在BoxNet3D-OBS（一个包含密集障碍物和最多九个机器人的高难度多机器人基准测试）上的实验表明，相较于忽略运动规划的基线方法和基于VLA的方法，我们的方法能持续提升任务成功率。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/navigate-cluster。

title: Self-Predictive Representation for Autonomous UAV Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have revolutionized industries through their versatility with applications including aerial surveillance, search and rescue, agriculture, and delivery. Their autonomous capabilities offer unique advantages, such as operating in large open space environments. Reinforcement Learning (RL) empowers UAVs to learn intricate navigation policies, enabling them to optimize flight behavior autonomously. However, one of its main challenge is the inefficiency in using data sample to achieve a good policy. In object-goal navigation (OGN) settings, target recognition arises as an extra challenge. Most UAV-related approaches use relative or absolute coordinates to move from an initial position to a predefined location, rather than to find the target directly. This study addresses the data sample efficiency issue in solving a 3D OGN problem, in addition to, the formalization of the unknown target location setting as a Markov decision process. Experiments are conducted to analyze the interplay of different state representation learning (SRL) methods for perception with a model-free RL algorithm for planning in an autonomous navigation system. The main contribution of this study is the development of the perception module, featuring a novel self-predictive model named AmelPred. Empirical results demonstrate that its stochastic version, AmelPredSto, is the best-performing SRL model when combined with actor-critic RL algorithms. The obtained results show substantial improvement in RL algorithms' efficiency by using AmelPredSto in solving the OGN problem.
tldr: This paper introduces a self-predictive state representation learning model (AmelPredSto) to improve sample efficiency for UAV object-goal navigation using model-free RL. It formalizes the problem as an MDP and demonstrates performance gains in a 3D OGN task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种自预测状态表示学习模型（AmelPredSto），用于通过无模型强化学习提高无人机目标导向导航的样本效率，将问题形式化为MDP，并在3D OGN任务中展示了性能提升。
summary_zh: 自主无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）以其多功能性革新了诸多行业，广泛应用于空中监视、搜救、农业和物流配送等领域。其自主能力赋予独特优势，例如能在广阔开放空间环境中作业。强化学习（RL）技术使无人机能够学习复杂的导航策略，从而自主优化飞行行为。然而，其主要挑战之一在于数据样本利用效率低下，难以获得理想策略。在目标导向导航（OGN）场景中，目标识别构成了额外挑战。现有多数无人机相关方法采用相对或绝对坐标实现从初始位置到预设地点的移动，而非直接寻找目标。本研究针对三维OGN问题中的数据样本效率难题展开探讨，同时将未知目标定位场景形式化为马尔可夫决策过程。通过实验分析不同状态表征学习（SRL）感知方法与无模型强化学习规划算法在自主导航系统中的协同机制。本研究的核心贡献在于开发了感知模块，其特点是引入名为AmelPred的新型自预测模型。实验结果表明，其随机版本AmelPredSto与行动者-评论家强化学习算法结合时，表现出最优的SRL模型性能。实验数据证实，在解决OGN问题时使用AmelPredSto能显著提升强化学习算法的效率。

title: Impact-Aware Model Predictive Control for UAV Landing on a Heaving Platform
summary: Landing UAVs on heaving marine platforms is challenging because relative vertical motion can generate large impact forces and cause rebound on touchdown. To address this, we develop an impact-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that models landing as a velocity-level rigid-body impact governed by Newton's restitution law. We embed this as a linear complementarity problem (LCP) within the MPC dynamics to predict the discontinuous post-impact velocity and suppress rebound. In simulation, restitution-aware prediction reduces pre-impact relative velocity and improves landing robustness. Experiments on a heaving-deck testbed show an 86.2% reduction in post-impact deflection compared to a tracking MPC.
tldr: The paper presents a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for UAV landing on moving platforms that incorporates a rigid-body impact model to predict and suppress rebound forces, improving landing robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于无人机在移动平台上着陆的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，该框架融合了刚体冲击模型，以预测并抑制反弹力，从而提高着陆的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在颠簸的海洋平台上降落无人机是一项极具挑战性的任务，因为垂向的相对运动会产生巨大的冲击力，导致着陆瞬间发生反弹。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种冲击感知的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，将着陆过程建模为遵循牛顿恢复定律的刚体速度层面冲击动力学。该框架将着陆冲击建模为线性互补问题（LCP），并将其嵌入MPC的动态模型中，以预测冲击后速度的突变并有效抑制反弹。仿真结果表明，该恢复感知预测方法显著降低了冲击前的相对速度，提升了着陆的鲁棒性。在模拟甲板垂荡运动的试验平台上进行的实验显示，与传统的跟踪式MPC相比，该方法使冲击后的偏移量减少了86.2%。

title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
summary: Autonomous medical robots hold promise to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider workload, democratize access to care, and enable superhuman precision. However, autonomous medical robotics has been limited by a fundamental data problem: existing medical robotic datasets are small, single-embodiment, and rarely shared openly, restricting the development of foundation models that the field needs to advance. We introduce Open-H-Embodiment, the largest open dataset of medical robotic video with synchronized kinematics to date, spanning more than 49 institutions and multiple robotic platforms including the CMR Versius, Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci, da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), Rob Surgical BiTrack, Virtual Incision's MIRA, Moon Surgical Maestro, and a variety of custom systems, spanning surgical manipulation, robotic ultrasound, and endoscopy procedures. We demonstrate the research enabled by this dataset through two foundation models. GR00T-H is the first open foundation vision-language-action model for medical robotics, which is the only evaluated model to achieve full end-to-end task completion on a structured suturing benchmark (25% of trials vs. 0% for all others) and achieves 64% average success across a 29-step ex vivo suturing sequence. We also train Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, the first action-conditioned world model to enable multi-embodiment surgical simulation from a single checkpoint, spanning nine robotic platforms and supporting in silico policy evaluation and synthetic data generation for the medical domain. These results suggest that open, large-scale medical robot data collection can serve as critical infrastructure for the research community, enabling advances in robot learning, world modeling, and beyond.
tldr: This paper introduces Open-H-Embodiment, a large-scale dataset for medical robotics, and presents two foundation models for robot control and simulation in this domain.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Open-H-Embodiment，这是一个用于医疗机器人技术的大规模数据集，并展示了该领域用于机器人控制和模拟的两个基础模型。
summary_zh: 自主医疗机器人有望改善患者预后、减轻医护人员负担、普及医疗服务并实现超乎人类的精准操作。然而，该领域的发展长期受制于一个根本性数据问题：现有医疗机器人数据集规模小、局限于单一设备形态且极少公开共享，阻碍了推动该领域进步所需的基础模型开发。我们推出Open-H-Embodiment数据集——迄今为止最大的同步运动学信息的开源医疗机器人视频数据集，涵盖全球49个以上机构及多类机器人平台，包括CMR Versius、直觉外科达芬奇系统、达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）、Rob Surgical BiTrack、Virtual Incision MIRA、Moon Surgical Maestro以及多种定制系统，覆盖外科手术操作、机器人超声与内窥镜检查等多个领域。我们通过两个基础模型展示了该数据集支撑的研究成果：GR00T-H作为首个开源的医疗机器人视觉-语言-动作基础模型，在结构化缝合基准测试中成为唯一实现端到端任务完成的评估模型（成功率25%，其他模型均为0%），并在包含29个步骤的离体缝合序列中实现平均64%的成功率。同时，我们训练出Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator——首个基于动作条件的世界模型，能够通过单一检查点实现跨九种机器人平台的多形态手术模拟，支持医疗领域的虚拟策略评估与合成数据生成。这些研究表明，开放的大规模医疗机器人数据收集可作为研究界的关键基础设施，推动机器人学习、世界建模及其他领域的突破性进展。

title: Robustness Analysis of POMDP Policies to Observation Perturbations
summary: Policies for Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) are often designed using a nominal system model. In practice, this model can deviate from the true system during deployment due to factors such as calibration drift or sensor degradation, leading to unexpected performance degradation. This work studies policy robustness against deviations in the POMDP observation model. We introduce the Policy Observation Robustness Problem: to determine the maximum tolerable deviation in a POMDP's observation model that guarantees the policy's value remains above a specified threshold. We analyze two variants: the sticky variant, where deviations are dependent on state and actions, and the non-sticky variant, where they can be history-dependent. We show that the Policy Observation Robustness Problem can be formulated as a bi-level optimization problem in which the inner optimization is monotonic in the size of the observation deviation. This enables efficient solutions using root-finding algorithms in the outer optimization. For the non-sticky variant, we show that when policies are represented with finite-state controllers (FSCs) it is sufficient to consider observations which depend on nodes in the FSC rather than full histories. We present Robust Interval Search, an algorithm with soundness and convergence guarantees, for both the sticky and non-sticky variants. We show this algorithm has polynomial time complexity in the non-sticky variant and at most exponential time complexity in the sticky variant. We provide experimental results validating and demonstrating the scalability of implementations of Robust Interval Search to POMDP problems with tens of thousands of states. We also provide case studies from robotics and operations research which demonstrate the practical utility of the problem and algorithms.
tldr: This paper introduces and analyzes the Policy Observation Robustness Problem for POMDPs, developing algorithms to find the maximum tolerable deviation in the observation model that keeps a policy's value above a threshold.
tldr_zh: 本文针对POMDP提出了策略观测鲁棒性问题，并开发算法寻找保持策略价值高于特定阈值的观测模型最大可容忍偏差。
summary_zh: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）的策略通常基于标称系统模型进行设计。在实际应用中，由于校准漂移或传感器退化等因素，部署时该模型可能偏离真实系统，导致性能意外下降。本文研究了POMDP观测模型偏离情况下策略的鲁棒性。我们提出了策略观测鲁棒性问题：确定POMDP观测模型可容忍的最大偏差范围，以保证策略价值维持在指定阈值之上。我们分析了两种变体：粘滞变体（偏差依赖于状态和动作）和非粘滞变体（偏差可依赖于历史状态）。研究表明，策略观测鲁棒性问题可表述为双层优化问题，其中内层优化对观测偏差规模具有单调性。这一特性使得在外层优化中可采用求根算法实现高效求解。对于非粘滞变体，我们证明当策略用有限状态控制器（FSC）表示时，仅需考虑依赖于FSC节点而非完整历史记录的观测信息。我们提出了鲁棒区间搜索算法，该算法具有可靠性和收敛性保证，适用于粘滞与非粘滞两种变体。分析表明该算法在非粘滞变体中具有多项式时间复杂度，在粘滞变体中至多具有指数时间复杂度。实验验证了鲁棒区间搜索算法在数万状态规模的POMDP问题中的可扩展性，并通过机器人学和运筹学领域的案例研究展示了该问题与算法的实际应用价值。

title: Do MLLMs Understand Pointing? Benchmarking and Enhancing Referential Reasoning in Egocentric Vision
summary: Egocentric AI agents, such as smart glasses, rely on pointing gestures to resolve referential ambiguities in natural language commands. However, despite advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), current systems often fail to precisely ground the spatial semantics of pointing. Instead, they rely on spurious correlations with visual proximity or object saliency, a phenomenon we term "Referential Hallucination." To address this gap, we introduce EgoPoint-Bench, a comprehensive question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate and enhance multimodal pointing reasoning in egocentric views. Comprising over 11k high-fidelity simulated and real-world samples, the benchmark spans five evaluation dimensions and three levels of referential complexity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source models struggle with egocentric pointing, models fine-tuned on our synthetic data achieve significant performance gains and robust sim-to-real generalization. This work highlights the importance of spatially aware supervision and offers a scalable path toward precise egocentric AI assistants. Project page: https://guyyyug.github.io/EgoPoint-Bench/
tldr: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating egocentric pointing gesture understanding in Multimodal LLMs, highlighting a 'Referential Hallucination' problem and proposing a fine-tuning solution to improve spatial grounding for AI assistants like smart glasses.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在自我中心视角下理解指向手势能力的基准，指出了一个'指代幻觉'问题，并提出了一个微调方案以提升智能眼镜等AI助手空间定位的精确性。
summary_zh: 摘要：以自我为中心的人工智能代理（如智能眼镜）依赖指向手势来消解自然语言指令中的指代歧义。然而，尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）取得了进展，现有系统仍难以精确解析指向动作的空间语义。相反，它们往往依赖于与视觉邻近性或物体显著性之间的虚假关联，我们将这种现象称为“指代幻觉”。为填补这一空白，我们提出了EgoPoint-Bench——一个专为评估和增强以自我为中心视角下的多模态指向推理能力而设计的综合问答基准。该基准包含超过1.1万条高保真模拟与真实世界样本，涵盖五个评估维度和三个指代复杂性层级。大量实验表明，尽管当前最先进的专有模型和开源模型在处理自我中心指向任务时表现不佳，但基于我们合成数据微调的模型实现了显著的性能提升，并展现出强大的模拟到真实场景的泛化能力。本工作强调了空间感知监督的重要性，为构建精准的以自我为中心AI助手提供了可扩展的路径。项目页面：https://guyyyug.github.io/EgoPoint-Bench/

title: A Case Study in Recovery of Drones using Discrete-Event Systems
summary: Discrete-event systems and supervisory control theory provide a rigorous framework for specifying correct-by-construction behavior. However, their practical application to swarm robotics remains largely underexplored. In this paper, we investigate a topological recovery method based on discrete-event-systems within a swarm robotics context. We propose a hybrid architecture that combines a high-level discrete event systems supervisor with a low-level continuous controller, allowing lost drones to safely recover from fault or attack events and re-enter a controlled region. The method is demonstrated using ten simulated UAVs in the py-bullet-drones framework. We show recovery performance across four distinct scenarios, each with varying initial state estimates. Additionally, we introduce a secondary recovery supervisor that manages the regrouping process for a drone after it has re-entered the operational region.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid discrete-event systems and continuous control architecture for recovering lost drones in a swarm robotics context, demonstrated in simulation with UAVs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合离散事件系统和连续控制架构，用于在群体机器人中恢复丢失的无人机，并在模拟环境中使用无人机进行了演示。
summary_zh: 离散事件系统与监控理论为构建行为正确的系统提供了严谨的框架。然而，其在群体机器人领域的实际应用仍待深入探索。本文在群体机器人背景下研究了一种基于离散事件系统的拓扑恢复方法。我们提出一种混合架构，将高层离散事件系统监控器与底层连续控制器相结合，使得丢失的无人机能够从故障或攻击事件中安全恢复并重新进入受控区域。该方法在py-bullet-drones框架中使用十个模拟无人机进行验证。我们在四种不同场景中展示了恢复性能，每种场景均采用不同的初始状态估计。此外，我们还引入了一个次级恢复监控器，用于管理无人机重新进入操作区域后的重组过程。

title: Tempered Sequential Monte Carlo for Trajectory and Policy Optimization with Differentiable Dynamics
summary: We propose a sampling-based framework for finite-horizon trajectory and policy optimization under differentiable dynamics by casting controller design as inference. Specifically, we minimize a KL-regularized expected trajectory cost, which yields an optimal "Boltzmann-tilted" distribution over controller parameters that concentrates on low-cost solutions as temperature decreases. To sample efficiently from this sharp, potentially multimodal target, we introduce tempered sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC): an annealing scheme that adaptively reweights and resamples particles along a tempering path from a prior to the target distribution, while using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo rejuvenation to maintain diversity and exploit exact gradients obtained by differentiating through trajectory rollouts. For policy optimization, we extend TSMC via (i) a deterministic empirical approximation of the initial-state distribution and (ii) an extended-space construction that treats rollout randomness as auxiliary variables. Experiments across trajectory- and policy-optimization benchmarks show that TSMC is broadly applicable and compares favorably to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: This paper proposes a sampling-based framework for trajectory and policy optimization under differentiable dynamics, formulating control as inference and using a tempered SMC method with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for efficient sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于采样的轨迹和策略优化框架，在可微动力学下将控制器设计表述为推理问题，并使用带哈密顿蒙特卡洛的温控序列蒙特卡洛方法进行高效采样。
summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于采样的有限时域轨迹与策略优化框架，通过将控制器设计问题转化为推断问题实现可微动力学下的优化。具体而言，我们最小化KL正则化的期望轨迹成本，从而得到控制器参数上的最优"玻尔兹曼倾斜"分布，该分布在温度降低时会集中于低成本解区域。为高效采样这一尖锐且可能多峰的目标分布，我们提出调温序贯蒙特卡洛（TSMC）方法：该退火方案通过温度路径从先验分布向目标分布自适应调整粒子权重并进行重采样，同时利用哈密顿蒙特卡洛重生机制保持粒子多样性，并利用轨迹展开微分获得的精确梯度信息。对于策略优化，我们通过以下方式扩展TSMC：（1）对初始状态分布进行确定性经验近似；（2）采用扩展空间构造法，将轨迹展开的随机性视为辅助变量。在轨迹优化与策略优化基准测试中的实验表明，TSMC具有广泛适用性，其性能优于当前最先进的基准方法。

title: PREVENT-JACK: Context Steering for Swarms of Long Heavy Articulated Vehicles
summary: In this paper, we aim to extend the traditional point-mass-like robot representation in swarm robotics and instead study a swarm of long Heavy Articulated Vehicles (HAVs). HAVs are kinematically constrained, elongated, and articulated, introducing unique challenges. Local, decentralized coordination of these vehicles is motivated by many real-world applications. Our approach, Prevent-Jack, introduces the sparsely covered context steering framework in robotics. It fuses six local behaviors, providing guarantees against jackknifing and collisions at the cost of potential dead- and livelocks, tested for vehicles with up to ten trailers. We highlight the importance of the Evade Attraction behavior for deadlock prevention using a parameter study, and use 15,000 simulations to evaluate the swarm performance. Our extensive experiments and the results show that both the dead- and livelocks occur more frequently in larger swarms and denser scenarios, affecting a peak average of 27%/31% of vehicles. We observe that larger swarms exhibit increased waiting, while smaller swarms show increased evasion.
tldr: This paper introduces a context steering framework for coordinating swarms of long, heavy articulated vehicles, focusing on preventing jackknifing and collisions through decentralized local behaviors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于协调长重铰接车辆群的情境转向框架，专注于通过分散的局部行为防止折叠和碰撞。
summary_zh: 本文旨在扩展群体机器人学中传统的点质量式机器人表示方法，转而研究由长型重型铰接式车辆组成的群体。这类车辆在运动学上受约束、具有细长铰接结构，带来了独特的挑战。许多实际应用场景推动了对这些车辆进行局部分散式协调的需求。我们提出的Prevent-Jack方法引入了机器人学中稀疏覆盖的上下文转向框架，该框架融合了六种局部行为，以防止折叠碰撞为保障目标，但可能以陷入死锁或活锁为代价，该方法已在最多配备十节拖挂的车辆上通过测试。我们通过参数研究揭示了"规避吸引"行为对于预防死锁的重要性，并利用15,000次仿真实验评估群体性能。大量实验结果表明，死锁与活锁现象在规模更大、密度更高的群体中更为频繁，最高可影响平均27%/31%的车辆。研究观察到大规模群体中等待行为显著增加，而小规模群体则表现出更强的规避倾向。

title: Effects of Swarm Size Variability on Operator Workload
summary: Real-world deployments of human--swarm teams depend on balancing operator workload to leverage human strengths without inducing overload. A key challenge is that swarm size is often dynamic: robots may join or leave the mission due to failures or redeployment, causing abrupt workload fluctuations. Understanding how such changes affect human workload and performance is critical for robust human--swarm interaction design. This paper investigates how the magnitude and direction of changes in swarm size influence operator workload. Drawing on the concept of workload history, we test three hypotheses: (1) workload remains elevated following decreases in swarm size, (2) small increases are more manageable than large jumps, and (3) sufficiently large changes override these effects by inducing a cognitive reset. We conducted two studies (N = 34) using a monitoring task with simulated drone swarms of varying sizes. By varying the swarm size between episodes, we measured perceived workload relative to swarm size changes. Results show that objective performance is largely unaffected by small changes in swarm size, while subjective workload is sensitive to both change direction and magnitude. Small increases preserve lower workload, whereas small decreases leave workload elevated, indicating workload residue; large changes in either direction attenuate these effects, suggesting a reset response. These findings offer actionable guidance for managing swarm-size transitions to support operator workload in dynamic human--swarm systems.
tldr: This paper investigates how dynamic changes in robot swarm size affect human operator workload, finding that subjective workload is sensitive to both the direction and magnitude of change, offering insights for managing human-swarm interactions.
tldr_zh: 本研究探讨了机器人蜂群规模动态变化如何影响人类操作员的工作负荷，发现主观工作负荷对变化的幅度和方向均敏感，为管理动态人机群系统提供了指导。
summary_zh: 现实世界中的人-群体团队部署需要平衡操作员的工作负荷，既要发挥人的优势，又不能引发过载。一个关键挑战在于群体规模往往是动态变化的：机器人可能因故障或重新部署而加入或离开任务，导致工作负荷的突然波动。理解此类变化如何影响人的工作负荷与表现，对于构建稳健的人-群体交互设计至关重要。本文研究了群体规模变化的大小与方向对操作员工作负荷的影响。基于工作负荷历史的概念，我们检验了三个假设：（1）群体规模减少后工作负荷仍保持高位；（2）小幅增加比大幅跃升更易管理；（3）足够大的变化会通过引发认知重置而覆盖这些效应。我们通过两项研究（N=34），使用模拟无人机群监控任务对多种群体规模进行了测试。通过在不同任务阶段调整群体规模，我们测量了与规模变化相关的主观工作负荷。结果显示，客观表现基本不受群体规模小幅变化的影响，而主观工作负荷则对变化方向和幅度均敏感：小幅增加能维持较低负荷，小幅减少则使负荷保持高位，表明存在工作负荷残留；而大幅变化（无论方向）会减弱这些效应，暗示存在重置反应。这些发现为动态人-群体系统中管理群体规模转变、支持操作员工作负荷提供了切实可行的指导。

title: A Replicable Robotics Awareness Method Using LLM-Enabled Robotics Interaction: Evidence from a Corporate Challenge
summary: Large language models are increasingly being explored as interfaces between humans and robotic systems, yet there remains limited evidence on how such technologies can be used not only for interaction, but also as a structured means of introducing robotics to non-specialist users in real organizational settings. This paper introduces and evaluates a challenge-based method for robotics awareness, implemented through an LLM-enabled humanoid robot activity conducted with employees of AD Ports Group in the United Arab Emirates. In the event, participants engaged with a humanoid robot in a logistics-inspired task environment using voice commands interpreted through an LLM-based control framework. The activity was designed as a team-based, role-driven experience intended to expose participants to embodied AI and human-robot collaboration without requiring prior robotics expertise. To evaluate the approach, a post-event survey remained open for 16 days and collected 102 responses. Results indicate strong overall reception, with high satisfaction (8.46/10), increased interest in robotics and AI (4.47/5), and improved understanding of emerging forms of human-robot collaboration (4.45/5). Participants who interacted directly with the robot also reported natural interaction (4.37/5) and a strong sense that interaction became easier as the activity progressed (4.74/5). At the same time, lower ratings for reliability and predictability point to important technical and design challenges for future iterations. The findings suggest that challenge-based, LLM-enabled humanoid interaction can serve as a promising and replicable method for robotics awareness in industrial and operational environments.
tldr: This paper presents a method for raising robotics awareness in corporate settings using an LLM-enabled humanoid robot in a logistics-inspired task. The study reports high participant satisfaction and improved understanding of human-robot collaboration, but notes challenges with reliability and predictability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过LLM控制的人形机器人，在物流任务中提高企业员工对机器人认知度的研究方法。研究发现参与者满意度和对人机协作的理解均有提升，但可靠性和可预测性方面存在挑战。

title: Reasoning About Traversability: Language-Guided Off-Road 3D Trajectory Planning
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable high-level semantic reasoning for end-to-end autonomous driving, particularly in unstructured environments, existing off-road datasets suffer from language annotations that are weakly aligned with vehicle actions and terrain geometry. To address this misalignment, we propose a language refinement framework that restructures annotations into action-aligned pairs, enabling a VLM to generate refined scene descriptions and 3D future trajectories directly from a single image. To further encourage terrain-aware planning, we introduce a preference optimization strategy that constructs geometry-aware hard negatives and explicitly penalizes trajectories inconsistent with local elevation profiles. Furthermore, we propose off-road-specific metrics to quantify traversability compliance and elevation consistency, addressing the limitations of conventional on-road evaluation. Experiments on the ORAD-3D benchmark demonstrate that our approach reduces average trajectory error from 1.01m to 0.97m, improves traversability compliance from 0.621 to 0.644, and decreases elevation inconsistency from 0.428 to 0.322, highlighting the efficacy of action-aligned supervision and terrain-aware optimization for robust off-road driving.
tldr: This paper proposes a language refinement framework and preference optimization strategy to improve Vision-Language Models for 3D trajectory planning in off-road autonomous driving, enhancing action-alignment and terrain-aware reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语言精炼框架和偏好优化策略，用于改进视觉语言模型在越野自动驾驶中的三维轨迹规划，增强了动作对齐和地形感知能力。

title: A Systematic Review and Taxonomy of Reinforcement Learning-Model Predictive Control Integration for Linear Systems
summary: The integration of Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for constrained decision-making and adaptive control. MPC offers structured optimization, explicit constraint handling, and established stability tools, whereas RL provides data-driven adaptation and performance improvement in the presence of uncertainty and model mismatch. Despite the rapid growth of research on RL--MPC integration, the literature remains fragmented, particularly for control architectures built on linear or linearized predictive models. This paper presents a comprehensive Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of RL--MPC integrations for linear and linearized systems, covering peer-reviewed and formally indexed studies published until 2025. The reviewed studies are organized through a multi-dimensional taxonomy covering RL functional roles, RL algorithm classes, MPC formulations, cost-function structures, and application domains. In addition, a cross-dimensional synthesis is conducted to identify recurring design patterns and reported associations among these dimensions within the reviewed corpus. The review highlights methodological trends, commonly adopted integration strategies, and recurring practical challenges, including computational burden, sample efficiency, robustness, and closed-loop guarantees. The resulting synthesis provides a structured reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to design or analyze RL--MPC architectures based on linear or linearized predictive control formulations.
tldr: This paper is a systematic literature review and taxonomy focusing on the integration of Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Model Predictive Control (MPC) for linear systems, analyzing design patterns, trends, and challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文是一篇关于线性系统中强化学习与模型预测控制集成的系统性文献综述和分类法，分析了设计模式、趋势和挑战。

title: Reinforcing 3D Understanding in Point-VLMs via Geometric Reward Credit Assignment
summary: Point-Vision-Language Models promise to empower embodied agents with executable spatial reasoning, yet they frequently succumb to geometric hallucination where predicted 3D structures contradict the observed 2D reality. We identify a key cause of this failure not as a representation bottleneck but as a structural misalignment in reinforcement learning, where sparse geometric tokens are drowned out by noisy and broadcasted sequence-level rewards. To resolve this causal dilution, we propose Geometric Reward Credit Assignment, a framework that disentangles holistic supervision into field-specific signals and routes them exclusively to their responsible token spans. This mechanism transforms vague feedback into precise gradient updates and effectively turns generic policy optimization into targeted structural alignment. Furthermore, we internalize physical constraints via a Reprojection-Consistency term which serves as a cross-modal verifier to penalize physically impossible geometries. Validated on a calibrated benchmark derived from ShapeNetCore, our approach bridges the reliability gap by boosting 3D KPA from 0.64 to 0.93, increasing 3D bounding box intersection over union to 0.686, and raising reprojection consistency scores to 0.852. Crucially, these gains are achieved while maintaining robust 2D localization performance, marking a meaningful step from plausible textual outputs toward physically verifiable spatial predictions.
tldr: This paper addresses geometric hallucination in Point-Vision-Language Models by introducing a Geometric Reward Credit Assignment framework and a Reprojection-Consistency term to improve 3D structural understanding, validated on a ShapeNetCore benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过引入几何奖励信用分配框架和重投影一致性项来解决点视觉语言模型中的几何幻觉问题，从而提高3D结构理解能力，并在ShapeNetCore基准上进行了验证。

title: VLAA-GUI: Knowing When to Stop, Recover, and Search, A Modular Framework for GUI Automation
summary: Autonomous GUI agents face two fundamental challenges: early stopping, where agents prematurely declare success without verifiable evidence, and repetitive loops, where agents cycle through the same failing actions without recovery. We present VLAA-GUI, a modular GUI agentic framework built around three integrated components that guide the system on when to Stop, Recover, and Search. First, a mandatory Completeness Verifier enforces UI-observable success criteria and verification at every finish step -- with an agent-level verifier that cross-examines completion claims with decision rules, rejecting those lacking direct visual evidence. Second, a mandatory Loop Breaker provides multi-tier filtering: switching interaction mode after repeated failures, forcing strategy changes after persistent screen-state recurrence, and binding reflection signals to strategy shifts. Third, an on-demand Search Agent searches online for unfamiliar workflows by directly querying a capable LLM with search ability, returning results as plain text. We additionally integrate a Coding Agent for code-intensive actions and a Grounding Agent for precise action grounding, both invoked on demand when required. We evaluate VLAA-GUI across five top-tier backbones, including Opus 4.5, 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, on two benchmarks with Linux and Windows tasks, achieving top performance on both (77.5% on OSWorld and 61.0% on WindowsAgentArena). Notably, three of the five backbones surpass human performance (72.4%) on OSWorld in a single pass. Ablation studies show that all three proposed components consistently improve a strong backbone, while a weaker backbone benefits more from these tools when the step budget is sufficient. Further analysis also shows that the Loop Breaker nearly halves wasted steps for loop-prone models.
tldr: This paper introduces VLAA-GUI, a modular framework for GUI automation agents that addresses premature stopping and repetitive action loops via three key components: a mandatory Completeness Verifier for success verification, a Loop Breaker for strategy recovery, and an on-demand Search Agent for unfamiliar workflows. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on desktop OS automation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出VLAA-GUI，一个用于GUI自动化的模块化框架，通过三个核心组件解决智能体过早停止和重复循环问题：强制完整性验证器、循环中断器和按需搜索代理。该框架在桌面操作系统自动化基准测试中实现了顶尖性能。

title: Symbolic Grounding Reveals Representational Bottlenecks in Abstract Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) often fail on abstract visual reasoning benchmarks such as Bongard problems, raising the question of whether the main bottleneck lies in reasoning or representation. We study this on Bongard-LOGO, a synthetic benchmark of abstract concept learning with ground-truth generative programs, by comparing end-to-end VLMs on raw images with large language models (LLMs) given symbolic inputs derived from those images. Using symbolic inputs as a diagnostic probe rather than a practical multimodal architecture, our \emph{Componential--Grammatical (C--G)} paradigm reformulates Bongard-LOGO as a symbolic reasoning task based on LOGO-style action programs or structured descriptions. LLMs achieve large and consistent gains, reaching mid--90s accuracy on Free-form problems, while a strong visual baseline remains near chance under matched task definitions. Ablations on input format, explicit concept prompts, and minimal visual grounding show that these factors matter much less than the shift from pixels to symbolic structure. These results identify representation as a key bottleneck in abstract visual reasoning and show how symbolic input can serve as a controlled diagnostic upper bound.
tldr: Paper finds representation (not reasoning) is the key bottleneck for VLMs on abstract visual reasoning by comparing them to LLMs given symbolic inputs, using a synthetic benchmark with ground-truth programs.
tldr_zh: 论文通过对比在原始图像上训练的VLM与使用符号输入的LLM在合成基准测试上的表现，发现表示（而非推理）是抽象视觉推理的主要瓶颈。

title: Exploring the Role of Synthetic Data Augmentation in Controllable Human-Centric Video Generation
summary: Controllable human video generation aims to produce realistic videos of humans with explicitly guided motions and appearances,serving as a foundation for digital humans, animation, and embodied AI.However, the scarcity of largescale, diverse, and privacy safe human video datasets poses a major bottleneck, especially for rare identities and complex actions.Synthetic data provides a scalable and controllable alternative,yet its actual contribution to generative modeling remains underexplored due to the persistent Sim2Real gap.In this work,we systematically investigate the impact of synthetic data on controllable human video generation. We propose a diffusion-based framework that enables fine-grained control over appearance and motion while providing a unfied testbed to analyze how synthetic data interacts with real world data during training.
